review_method: Independent physical-LF JSONL parsing and case-ID recount; exact suite selection and case artifact comparison; raw output hashes; both source manifests; all seven runtime/configuration pins rehashed. Acceptance-runner parser was not imported.

source_verification.carry_forward_reason: The accepted 514 cases depend on the unchanged Mail core, transport, UI, MIME, store, reader example and vendored enough_mail package closure plus unchanged root configuration and seven runtime/configuration pins. Incoming Office/VBA/Zotero/font/Studio changes are outside that closure. The complete Studio selection runs freshly on the merged source.

transitive_comparison.closure_rule: Entry package normal and dev dependencies, then recursive normal dependencies. All captured files under each resolved local package root plus four root configuration files are compared.
transitive_comparison.native_path_import_boundary: The test imports studio_native_paths.dart, which imports studio_data_root.dart; the latter imports Flutter foundation and external path_provider. The local files and package/root configuration are compared; external resolution and seven pins are unchanged.

studio.failure: Stale No messages expectation in search tolerates messages with an empty sender list; updated to new no-matches state and rerun.

excluded_attempt_results.derived_metadata_issue: Original Studio case IDs 212, 213 and 214 lost names/suite IDs because str.splitlines() treated valid Unicode NEL, LS and PS within JSON strings as separators. Raw event logs are intact. The original artifacts are preserved. The fresh runner parses physical LF boundaries; all accepted fresh case metadata matches raw events.

office_evidence_boundary: Prior Office acceptance and any new merged-Office qualification are tracked separately. No Office cases are added to Mail or ancillary totals in this review.
qualification_boundary: Linux Dart/Flutter VM plus three Node transport boundary suites; no live-provider or installed-platform qualification. Seven named runtime/configuration inputs are pinned; this does not claim a fully hermetic dependency snapshot.

superseded_studio_acceptance.reason: Main advanced with Office/Studio transitive source changes; fresh Studio and spaCy runs on merged source supersede those intermediate runs. The independent native-path source proof permits its two cases to carry forward.

separate_office_acceptance.review_boundary: Accepted Office report and checkpoint binding checked; raw Office tests were independently qualified by the incoming-office agent, not rerun or added to this Mail review.
